app.engineTuning.cloudMaxChatLoopIterati: Cloud models can keep working far longer than a local GPU, so this sits well above the local limit.
app.engineTuning.cloudMaxTaskLoopIterati: The same limit for task mode on a cloud model.
app.engineTuning.cloudMaxToolCallsPerSes: A safety cap on tool calls across a whole conversation on a cloud model. It already sits at its maximum, so it can only be lowered.
app.engineTuning.cloudMaxToolsPerTurnHel: How many tool calls a cloud model may make while answering one message.
app.engineTuning.cloudMaxWebToolCallsPer: How many web searches or page fetches one reply may use on a cloud model.
app.engineTuning.cloudToolsExecutionTime: How long a single tool call may run on a cloud model before it is stopped.
app.engineTuning.contextCompactionHelp: Applies to every engine. A per-model summarization threshold set in Models -> Tune wins over the global ratio here.
app.engineTuning.delegationHelp: Sub-agent fan-out. Tool calls within a single turn always run one at a time; delegation is the only place Jenny works in parallel.
app.engineTuning.maxBudgetUsdHelp: Stop a reply once the provider cost for that turn passes this amount. Leave blank for no cap.
app.engineTuning.maxChatLoopIterationsHe: How many times Jenny may stop to think again after running tools during an ordinary chat reply.
app.engineTuning.maxCloudSubAgentConcurr: How many delegated helper tasks may run at once on a cloud model. The scheduler caps this at 3.
app.engineTuning.maxCodeIntelligenceTool: How many code-analysis tool calls one reply may use.
app.engineTuning.maxInlinePayloadBytesHe: Tool output bigger than this is saved to a file and linked, instead of being pasted into the conversation.
app.engineTuning.maxLoopIterationsHelp: Only used when resource discipline is switched off. Also seeds the chat limit when that one is left unset.
app.engineTuning.maxLoopWallSecondsHelp: How long a local turn may spend actively working. Time waiting for your approval or your answers does not count against this limit.
app.engineTuning.maxSubAgentConcurrencyH: How many delegated helper tasks may run at the same time on a local model. 1 means one after another.
app.engineTuning.maxSubAgentLoopIteratio: How many thinking rounds each helper task gets. Kept the same for local and cloud on purpose: a bigger job should spawn more helpers, not longer ones.
app.engineTuning.maxTaskLoopIterationsHe: The same limit for task mode, where longer multi-step work is expected.
app.engineTuning.maxToolCallsPerSessionH: A safety cap on tool calls across a whole conversation, so a runaway loop cannot keep going forever.
app.engineTuning.maxToolsPerTurnHelp: How many tool calls (file reads, web searches, and so on) Jenny may make while answering one message. Raise it for long, tool-heavy jobs; lower it to keep replies quick.
app.engineTuning.maxWebToolCallsPerTurnH: How many web searches or page fetches one reply may use. Only successful calls count; failures are refunded.
app.engineTuning.modelLoadGraceSecondsHe: How long to wait for the first words while a local model is still loading into GPU memory. Raise it for very large models or slow disks.
app.engineTuning.ollamaRequestTimeoutSec: How long a single request to Ollama may take before it is abandoned.
app.engineTuning.reasoningHelp: Each round is one model generation plus the tool calls it requests. Raising these lets a turn work longer before it is cut off.
app.engineTuning.spendHelp: A hard stop on what one reply may cost on a paid provider.
app.engineTuning.timeoutsHelp: How long Jenny waits before giving up on a tool, a model load, or a request.
app.engineTuning.tokenBudgetAutoCompactR: When the conversation fills this share of the model's context window, older messages are summarized automatically. Lower values summarize sooner.
app.engineTuning.tokenBudgetReservedForS: Room kept free in the context window for the summary that compaction writes.
app.engineTuning.tokenBudgetToolOverhead: Extra room assumed for each tool call when estimating how full the context window is.
app.engineTuning.tokenBudgetWarningRatio: When the conversation fills this share of the context window, Jenny warns that summarization is coming.
app.engineTuning.toolBudgetsHelp: Caps on how much tool work a reply, or a whole conversation, may do.
app.engineTuning.toolsExecutionTimeoutSe: How long a single tool call may run before it is stopped. The shell tool can also set its own per-call limit.
app.engineTuning.toolsGitTimeoutSecondsH: How long a single git command may run before it is stopped.
app.engineTuning.toolsPythonRuntimeMaxMe: The most memory a Python snippet may use.
app.engineTuning.toolsPythonRuntimeTimeo: How long a Python snippet may run before it is stopped.
